decision: Merge the train stack into main, then keep feature PRs at most 7 days old.
options: A: merge the draft 'main into train 7' (tree-identical to train 7), let the Mac run L4.all + the full e2e, then promote:main by fast-forward
B: force main to train 7 (rewrites main; forbidden by the lane rules and by the ruleset W10.O1 wants)
C: keep waiting for more trains before main moves
why: main (7fc2e65364) is NOT an ancestor of verify/train-7 (f090c20812): main holds #432's 3 commits, so promote:main (fast-forward only) cannot take any train today. The draft merge resolves the two conflicts to train 7's side and leaves the tree byte-identical to train 7 (git diff empty), so the same-tree rule of promote-main.mjs lets train 7's e2e receipt count. 100 PRs are open and every one of them is older than 7 days (created before 9.11): the 7-day rule is only reachable after main moves.
changes: merge the OWNER-DECISION draft branch fix/g6-L4-main-into-train7 into verify/train-7 (integrator)

decision: Invite a public review of the sync crypto (spec + vectors + Python decoder), and decide hand-rolled vs hash-wasm/typage.

B: install hash-wasm + typage on the Mac (W10.M2) and switch before any review
C: wait for a paid external audit (W10.O8) before anything
recommendation: A, plus run cryptoDifferential.test.ts on the Mac (it compares against @noble and typage once installed)
why: The plan step names hash-wasm/typage, but the shipped code is already differential-tested; a public invitation (GitHub Discussions, Security category) costs nothing and is the acceptance's missing piece. The npm registry is closed in the cloud, so B is a Mac step anyway; C has no budget.
changes: turn on Discussions (W10.O1), post docs/sync-protocol.md + the vectors under Security
W1.7 acceptance 'independent decoder' → already in the spec PR #399

B: keep issues as the forum, no GIFs

decision: Hold the Hebrew usability rounds (5–8 sessions per round).

B: one round of 5 now, the second after the fixes

decision: Should PR branches get a Vercel preview build (and so a failure status)?
options: A: keep only main and verify/* building (as scripts/vercel-ignore.sh does), and accept that a PR's status comes from its train
B: set LUMEN_BUILD_ALL=1 in the Vercel project so every branch builds
C: build PRs only when labelled
why: The free plan has 100 builds a day and one slot; the owner moved full verification to the Mac. Every PR in this repo reaches main only through a train, which IS built and gated. B would queue ~100 previews behind each train.
sources: memory: builds run on the Mac
changes: none (A keeps today's file); with B: Vercel project env LUMEN_BUILD_ALL=1

options: A: all of them now, the ruleset from security/github-ruleset.json with the owner in bypass for PRs only
B: reporting + scanning now, the ruleset after main moves (W10.O4)

SECURITY.md on main already links the advisory form, which does not work while reporting is off (see the W1.1 draft).

decision: Create the reviewer signing keys (Ed25519) and a second reviewer, then sign the Z2 receipts.
options: A: owner key now + a second reviewer from W10.O8
B: owner key only (pr:check counts receipts only from listed keys; a single reviewer cannot review own PRs)
why: security/reviewers.json has reviewers: {} — no receipt counts today. Keys are made outside every repo and the entry only counts after the change that adds it is merged (merge-base rule), so this must happen before the next review round.

paste the printed entry under reviewers in security/reviewers.json (sensitive file, CODEOWNERS)

decision: Set the Vercel project's Ignored Build Step to `bash scripts/vercel-ignore.sh`.
options: A: dashboard (Settings → Git → Ignored Build Step → Custom)
B: vercel api PATCH with commandForIgnoringBuildStep (the command in scripts/check-vercel-ignore.mjs)
recommendation: B (one command, and check:vercel-ignore verifies it)
why: vercel.ts is compiled after the ignore step, so its ignoreCommand is never read; until the project setting is set every push takes the one build slot. The cloud cannot read the setting: check:vercel-ignore exits 2 without VERCEL_TOKEN, and the project summary read through the Vercel connector (16.11) does not include it.

decision: Same setting as W10.O3 (the check is wired; only the project setting is owed).
options: see W10.O3
why: check:vercel-ignore is in the train and reports 'unknown' (exit 2) without a token, never a pass.

decision: Promote main to the train: fast-forward, tag, smoke, rollback plan.
options: A: merge the W1.1 draft into the train, Mac e2e receipt for its head, then promote:main --push, tag, smoke lumen-md.vercel.app; rollback = Vercel 'promote previous deployment'
B: promote train 6 first (older, smaller)
why: promote-main.mjs refuses anything but a fast-forward with a signed e2e receipt for the same tree. Today the fast-forward is impossible (see W1.1); the draft fixes that without changing the tree.

decision: Make the offline release key and updater pubkey, sign beta.1, run the beta.1→beta.2 drill.
options: A: minisign/Tauri key pair generated offline on the Mac, backed up in two offline places; LUMEN_UPDATER_PUBKEY set for the build
B: wait for SignPath (W11.S15) first
recommendation: A (Windows Authenticode is separate; the Tauri update signature is mandatory and independent of it)
why: tauri.conf.json reads the updater pubkey from ${LUMEN_UPDATER_PUBKEY}; without it no update is accepted (manifest_sig.rs no_key_means_no_update, which passes in the cloud with rustc --test). The Rust side of the drill (update_guard: newer only, never below the highest installed) passes 4/4 in the cloud.
changes: npm run release -- --publish beta.1, then beta.2; spctl -a -vv on macOS

decision: Deploy the content-frame site, the share server + relay, the mirror Worker; request a rescan.

B: one at a time, relay first (VITE_SYNC_RELAY_URL unblocks 10.53)
recommendation: B: relay first (fixes H1/H2 in 23c997bcfe pushed to #664 after approval), then content frame (lumen-md-frame.pages.dev in the CSP), then share server and mirror
why: The CSP already names https://lumen-md-frame.pages.dev as frame-src; until it is live every content-frame embed fails. The relay unlocks classroom sync (10.53).

A keeps the feature for self-hosters at zero cost and zero data. web-vitals: keep the own implementation (7/7 tests) unless the Mac run shows a mismatch.
